meta.policy: Keep a queen Miles bed with both sides reachable; keep at least today's storage; keep the laundry sorter in the room; every everyday route at least 22 inches wide; priorities in order: everyday walkway, storage, fewest changes, cost.
meta.scenario_basis: Joint scenarios, not confidence bounds. Worst plausible: narrower room, 2.75-in stools, 19-in nightstand and camera hinge shifted north.

search.retained: Pareto/cluster representatives ordered by route, known storage, changes, dated cost; if none pass, show explicitly invalid diagnostic options, never recommendations.

verdict: No wall-anchored candidate passes the draft brief. These are comparison options, not recommendations: east-wall bed access and north-window clearance conflict; turning north trades that for window or side-access conflicts.

ruled_out: Miles 60-inch dresser: excluded by the owner; west usable span is about 56.9 ± 1.4 in.
Head west: not allowed by this brief and the west doors leave no continuous queen headboard span.
Head south: headboard/nightstands or the bed conflict with the closet swing; not quietly relaxed.
Head east, wall anchored: clearing the east glass limits the north bed edge to 20.5 in, less than the 22-in disk route target; a wider north-side aisle overlaps the operable glass.
Head north, wall anchored: the clear span east of the north window leaves too little east-side access; centring the bed blocks the north glass.
Unknown drawer travel or unknown storage volume is not treated as a verified pass.
